tools.name: build_retirement_plan
tools.description:
Use when someone asks when they can retire, if their money will last, their FIRE number (the planner shows when
they'd reach it), or about Coast, Barista, Lean or Fat FIRE, and gave numbers (age, income, savings, spending,
debts). Send what they gave, as said. Returns its answer and plan link.

Turn

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: build_retirement_plan · Public sink: build_retirement_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: build_retirement_plan · Public sink: build_retirement_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
